name: admedco-mobilix-mes
description: ADMEDCO & MOBILIX - Production Management System. Standalone dual-factory MES: Next.js App Router + SQLite (Prisma). No Docker, no PostgreSQL.

scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset --skip-generate && prisma generate && node -r ./scripts/node-userinfo.cjs ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs prisma/seed.ts
scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && node -r ./scripts/node-userinfo.cjs ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs prisma/seed.ts
